## Common fixes

**Windows SmartScreen warns me on first run.**
Master Keybind Chart isn't code-signed yet. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

**My license key won't activate.**
Keys bind to one machine. If you've moved computers, go to your
[account page](https://kvrnl.io/account/) and click **Release device**, then activate again.

**I lost my key.**
It's always on your [account page](https://kvrnl.io/account/) — log in and it's there.

**The app won't update.**
Grab the latest installer from
[https://kvrnl.io/products/master-keybind-chart/](https://kvrnl.io/products/master-keybind-chart/) and install over the top.
Your settings are kept.
